source_scope: Original SEC 10-Q dated August 31, 2026, filed September 11; all comparative facts available only as of this eligible filing for this analysis
units: USD millions for cash and contractual schedule; USD billions for long-term RPO and future leases

source.source_review: SEC primary HTML manually reviewed for exact cash flow, Note 1, Note 6, and MD&A. Archived full-original sha was independently pinned previously, but these additional extracted tables have NOT undergone separate original-byte replay.

rpo.note: Management's expected recognition of customer obligations, not collected cash, unconditional customer deposits, AI-specific revenue, or guaranteed realization. Dollar values mechanically derived from approximate percentages.

capital_and_supply_commitments.note: $288bn future lease commitments not recognized in current lease liabilities or disclosed maturities. Purchase obligations primarily component/power supply. These contract buckets must not be indiscriminately added; overlap and time bases differ.

cash_bridge_fiscal_2027_q1.note: $11,363m is embedded IN GAAP CFO; do not add to CFO or RPO. CFO less this specific item is only arithmetic sensitivity, NOT recalculated GAAP CFO or recurring cash generation. $19,909m ATM is financing cash flow, NOT revenue. Unpaid capex $6,247m is noncash disclosure and must not be added to paid capex as if already disbursed.

year_over_year_reconciliation.source: SEC 10-Q, comparative quarterly cash flow statement and MD&A free cash flow reconciliation. Prior comparative prepayment line is a dash. Both periods use this filing vintage, available 2026-09-25.
